_comment: Canonical X-trace back-walk for xtrace_backcone.v. Full X-trace requires a loaded VCD (XTraceRequest.simulationTime); without one the service returns noVcdLoaded. This fixture captures the topological back-cone chain the §4.2 integration test asserts once the design is seeded with a VCD whose X originates at buf1 (foundOrigin). The chain is ordered selection -> origin. Maintained in tool/generate_pro_verification_fixtures.dart.
